rules.title: Boston fair housing protections (incl. rental assistance / Section 8 vouchers)
rules.requirement: Landlords in Boston may not discriminate against renters based on protected traits, including rental assistance such as Section 8, disability or veterans vouchers. Refusing to accept rental assistance is illegal housing discrimination.
rules.citation: Boston Fair Housing Regulations (Boston Fair Housing Commission)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance. This includes Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
rules.effective_date_note: Document does not state an effective date.
rules.penalty: Complaints investigated by the Fair Housing Commission, which tries to resolve them.

parsed.doc_summary: Boston Fair Housing Commission page listing protected classes, including rental assistance (Section 8 and other vouchers), and stating that refusing vouchers is illegal discrimination. It has no content on rent, eviction, deposits, fees or algorithmic pricing.
